findings.root_cause: Action export has create/update/transition/delete only; assignee is persisted at creation, never in update; checklist has inserts/reads but no completion write in production src.

findings.title: Calibration current-setting and aging unavailable through application
findings.root_cause: Permission map excludes MAKE_CURRENT/MARK_DUE/MARK_OVERDUE/SUPERSEDE; use case denies these domain actions before repository.

findings.title: Issue Slip confirmations remain creator attestations
findings.root_cause: One creator records all three role checkpoints; no independent signer/reauth ceremony. Canonical module docs explicitly allow attestations, while per-action signature mapping remains owner-unresolved; cannot claim three signer approval.

findings.root_cause: Production validateExecution does nothing while Submit invokes it; source-dependent execution/environment checks need approved authority and implementation.

findings.root_cause: Default policy throws POLICY_SOURCE_REQUIRED; no approved retest authority/count/effect policy is composed.

findings.title: RCA mutation transport always forbids
findings.root_cause: Exported transition action unconditionally throws FORBIDDEN, so backend state-machine/use-case presence is not an operational RCA workflow.

findings.title: Task dependencies/comments lack production operations and blocker enforcement
findings.root_cause: Canonical foundation model names task_comments/task_dependencies; DB types exist, but tasks production module has no reader/writer/action for either. mapTask hardcodes unresolvedMandatoryBlocker:false, so no mandatory-dependency/blocker truth is consulted by assertCompletable. Specialized record link is also absent; recurrence remains explicitly deferred.
findings.limits: Logical comments/dependencies foundation is not a standalone approved operational REQ ID; retained as architecture/functionality gap, not invented approval policy. Mandatory blockers are explicit TR-TASK-005 precondition.

findings.title: Task completion idempotency and locked prerequisite recheck unavailable
findings.root_cause: TransitionTaskUseCase reads/validates before repository mutation. Repository locks task but does not call assertCompletable or transitionTask against locked checklist/evidence; it writes mapped next state. It has no idempotency-record/replay path; a repeated successful COMPLETE encounters COMPLETED and is denied instead of returning prior success. Canonical TR-TASK-005 explicitly requires idempotent YES.
findings.limits: Static evidence of missing coordination; race reproduction and actual PostgreSQL completion retries not run.

findings.title: Lab equipment append does not lock/recheck parent state or version
findings.root_cause: Use case authorizes expectedVersion/DRAFT before asset capture; linkRunEquipment accepts neither expectedVersion nor prior state and begins independent insert/audit/outbox transaction without locking parent. Another submit/approve can commit before insert, so frozen evidence can gain new equipment rows without lab version change.
findings.limits: Direct source race analysis; PostgreSQL contention reproduction and trigger behavior not executed by subtask.
